use.title: Use the assistant
use.description: Open the assistant and ask it things.

manage_providers.title: Manage providers
manage_providers.description: Add, edit and remove the AI providers and their API keys.

apply_proposals.title: Apply proposals
apply_proposals.description: Let the assistant carry out the changes it suggests.

services.use.title: Use AI from other features
services.use.description: Other features may call the assistant on your behalf.

secrets.share.title: Share the API key
secrets.share.description: Other features may use the stored AI API key without seeing it.

manage_updates.title: Manage application updates
manage_updates.description: Configure and request opt-in Docker updates; administrator settings permission is also required.

settings.assistantUnavailable: The AI assistant is turned off on this server.
settings.providersNeedOptIn: Turn on the AI assistant above to add providers.

globallyEnabled.label: AI assistant
globallyEnabled.description: Let users turn on the AI assistant. While this is off, the assistant is hidden and blocked for everyone.

privateEndpoints.label: Allowed private AI hosts
privateEndpoints.description: Hosts on your private network that users may point a provider at, such as a self-hosted Ollama. Put one host on each line.

enableAiAssistant.label: Enable AI Assistant
enableAiAssistant.description: Allow the AI assistant to help in this host's terminal. Off by default, and still needs AI enabled for your account.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.inputPlaceholder: Ask about your servers, or describe a change to propose
ai.privateEndpointHint: Addresses on your private network need an administrator to allow the host first.
ai.enableDescription: Let the assistant read your setup and suggest changes for you to approve.
ai.readOnlyCommandsDescription: The assistant may run a short list of safe commands like df and uptime without asking each time. Anything that changes a server is always proposed first.
ai.modelDetectFailed: Could not reach the provider, so this is a general list. You can type any model name.
ai.modelPlaceholder: Select or enter a model ID
ai.attachHint: Type @ to reference a host, snippet or automation. Changes are proposed for you to approve.
ai.terminalPanelEmpty: Ask the assistant about this host. Anything that changes state needs your approval first.
ai.noProvidersConfigured: No AI provider is configured yet. Add one in the AI assistant tab.
ai.runsInOpenTerminal: Runs in your open terminal session.

secrets.shareApiKey: Let other features use your AI provider API key for their own requests. The key is never copied, and you can revoke this at any time.

ai.modelDiscoveryFallback: Model discovery is unavailable. You can still enter a supported model ID.
ai.sessionModeHint: Model and execution mode apply to this conversation.
ai.autoModeWarning: AI may run commands and make changes without asking again. Mistakes can delete data or interrupt services. Existing access permissions still apply. Enable only on a trusted test host.
ai.autoModeActive: Automatic execution is ON. New conversations return to approval mode.
ai.summarizeResult: Explain the recorded action result. Do not execute it again.
ai.collaborativeTerminal: Bound to {{host}}. AI runs through an independent SSH channel while you keep using your terminal. Shell state is not shared.
ai.chatWelcome: Start a conversation or use @ to reference a host. The assistant can read its recent terminal output. Model and execution options are in Chat settings.
ai.historyHostMismatch: This conversation belongs to another terminal
ai.terminalSharedWarning: This sends the command to your existing SSH terminal, not an isolated exec session. Run only when the shell is idle. The assistant cannot verify completion or the exit status automatically; attach the terminal output for analysis.
ai.terminalSubmittedUnverified: Sent to the visible SSH terminal; execution result and exit status are not verified. Ask the user to attach terminal output before reporting success.
ai.terminalSendUnavailable: Terminal disconnected or command has multiple lines; not sent
ai.terminalSubmitRecordFailed: Command may have been sent, but recording failed. Check the terminal; do not run it again blindly.
ai.sharedExecutionHint: Commands and output appear in this SSH terminal and results return automatically. Use an idle Bash/zsh prompt. Ctrl+C takes over. AI scripts inherit cwd/environment but cannot change the parent shell state.
ai.isolatedExecutionHint: Separate SSH exec channel; commands do not appear in the manual terminal.
ai.terminalContextAutomatic: The assistant can read recent output from your current SSH terminal or an @host when needed. No manual attachment is required.
ai.composerHint: Use @ to reference a host, snippet or automation. Terminal output is read by the assistant when needed.
ai.disableAutoHint: Click to return to per-command approval. Audit logging and permissions remain enabled.
ai.enableAutoHint: Click to enable automatic execution for this conversation without per-command prompts. Commands can change your server. Audit logging and permissions remain enabled.
ai.settingsDialogHint: Session settings. Close this floating window to return to chat.
ai.contextUsageDetail: Estimated input {{tokens}} + reserved output {{reserve}} / configured capacity {{capacity}} tokens. Compactions: {{count}}. Last upstream input count: {{actual}}. This is a heuristic estimate, not a tokenizer measurement.
ai.contextExplanation: Capacity must match your upstream model; it is not automatically detected. Usage estimates include system instructions, tool schemas, history and output reserve. At the threshold, older turns are summarized; long tool output can be shortened. Complete chat records remain stored. Summary calls use your selected model and incur API usage. Critical details can still be lost.
ai.updateActionError: Update action failed. Check administrator permissions, proxy settings and the updater status.
ai.updateScope: Tracks only ghcr.io/luoquan0/cat-termix:ai-dev. Never replaces this fork with upstream Termix.
ai.updateInstallHint: Updater not connected. One-time setup: start Compose with docker-compose.ai-test.yml AND docker-compose.ai-updates.yml. The Docker socket belongs only to the separate updater.
ai.updateRestartWarning: Updates restart the application and disconnect SSH sessions. In-flight AI requests are deferred. Only standard Docker + local SQLite is supported: a cold data snapshot is retained before replacement. Avoid editing data during maintenance.
ai.updateProxyHint: Optional proxy origin, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:7890. Used for both version checks and image layers, with TLS verification. Saved credentials are masked; leave the field unchanged to retain them, clear it to disable proxy.
ai.contextSourceUpstream: Live capacity reported by the upstream provider
ai.contextSourceCatalog: Published capacity from official model documentation
ai.contextSourceManual: Your saved override for this provider and model
ai.contextChooseModel: Select a provider and model to detect capacity
ai.contextUnknownWarning: This gateway did not report a reliable limit. Edit the capacity below to save it for this model. No capacity is guessed from model aliases.
ai.contextSaveFailed: Could not save model context override
ai.contextOverrideHint: Changing the capacity saves a model-specific override. Switching models restores that model's saved value; provider-reported limits may differ from actual proxy restrictions.
ai.updateSubmittingCheck: Sending check request to the updater...
ai.updateSubmittingApply: Sending update request to the updater...
ai.updateQueued: Check queued; waiting for the updater to pick it up (usually within 15 seconds).
ai.updateCheckingUpstream: Checking the latest Cat-Termix build on GHCR...
ai.updateDownloading: Downloading and verifying the new Docker image...
ai.updateBackingUp: Stopping the app and backing up its data...
ai.updateVerifying: Starting and health-checking the replacement container...
ai.updateRollingBack: New version failed; restoring the previous container and data...
ai.updateApplying: Updater acknowledged the request; preparing the update...
ai.updateCheckTimedOut: Update check did not start within 10 minutes. Check whether the updater is running and reachable.
ai.updateCheckFailed: Update check failed. See the message below or the updater logs.
ai.updateFound: Check complete: a newer Cat-Termix build is available.
ai.updateLatest: Check complete: Cat-Termix is already up to date.
ai.updateApplied: Update completed and the new build is healthy.
ai.updateDeferred: An AI request was active; the update has been deferred.
ai.updateIdle: Ready to check the published Cat-Termix build.
ai.updateRefreshError: Cannot refresh updater progress; connection may be interrupted. Retrying automatically.

onboarding.aiIntro: Termix can include an optional AI assistant. You can change this later in your settings.
onboarding.aiSkipDesc: Termix works as it does now. The assistant stays hidden.
onboarding.aiEnableDesc: Adds an assistant that reads your setup and suggests changes you approve. Needs a provider you supply, such as a local Ollama.
onboarding.aiNote: Nothing is sent anywhere until you add a provider and send a message.
